reasons.result_file_missing: the result file that feeds the slot does not exist yet (pull it, or run the job)
reasons.result_not_in_report: the result file exists but marks the block unavailable (an arm not run or not requested yet, or excluded): the detail quotes the report's own reason
reasons.branch_slot: branch:... alternatives (FILL RULE 4): keep the one that occurred; never written by this script
reasons.free_text: a sentence, clause or verdict to be written from the filled tables; not a result field
reasons.field_not_produced: no script writes this field (or the result file does not carry it)
reasons.field_null: the result file carries the field as null (not computable on its rows)
reasons.below_min_n: an interval-based claim on fewer than 150 users (A3 section 1): no direction word
reasons.ambiguous_slot: the sentence does not fix the panel, regime or field: no mechanical reading
reasons.not_decided: the registered test gives a mixed or partial outcome: the wording needs a written sentence
reasons.interpretive: interpretive wording that no registered test decides
reasons.incomplete_regime: a registered seed or run is missing (never replaced): the seed mean is not written
reasons.branch_not_taken: the block belongs to a branch that did not occur (gate decision): delete it, do not fill it
reasons.skeleton_changed: the slot text or table layout differs from TABLE_SPECS / PROSE_SPECS: update the spec first
reasons.to_be_removed: the main session drops this slot from the skeleton (decision 2026-10-04; no script writes it): it leaves this list when the skeleton edit lands
